correctness.rationale: The two-point conditional triangle kernel is a minor-angle triangular wave; its exact odd Fourier eigenvalues have squared sum giving kernel variance 1/48. Hoeffding variance decomposition gives Var(D_n)=3/[8(n-1)(n-2)]. Exchangeability gives an exact deletion mean square and expected jackknife factor. An independent deleted-angle mark coupled to the empirical Fourier CLT supplies the joint (quadratic,linear) chaos limit, the hyperbolic transform, and Cov(Z,J^2)=-9/20. The included standalone checker passed 70 assertions, but finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Simplicial depth is used for nonparametric centrality and location inference. A single observational loss yields a distinct Gaussian fluctuation on the n^{-3/2} scale, explicitly tied to a non-Gaussian global error despite zero correlation. The same proof supplies an exact every-n inflation ratio for the ordinary jackknife variance estimate. These are motivated sensitivity and uncertainty-calibration invariants, not arbitrary parameter slices or known-table recomputation.
